en: Review the current contact, ticket and amount. This creates one offline demo order. Total currency is unconfirmed; no payment or data sharing occurs.
zh-Hans: 请核对当前联系人、票种和金额。确认后仅创建一笔离线演示订单。总额币种尚未确认，不会支付或分享信息。

en: Your selection or session changed. Review the details again.
zh-Hans: 选择或登录状态已改变，请重新核对信息。

en: Choose a saved participant or enter details. Any edits here are used for this registration only.
zh-Hans: 选择已保存的参与人或直接填写。本页修改仅用于本次报名。

en: Creating an order is disabled until the app privacy policy, server-recorded data-sharing consent, protected intent recovery and order reconciliation are approved and integrated.
zh-Hans: 应用隐私政策、服务端信息分享同意记录、安全报名意图恢复及订单核对流程完成审核和接入前，无法创建订单。

en: Ticket and total currency are not supplied by this contract. Yuan-named deductions are shown in CNY. Amounts are never converted to USD.
zh-Hans: 此接口未提供票价和总额的币种。以“元”命名的抵扣项显示为 CNY，不换算为美元。

en: Demo only: confirm the contact-sharing step
zh-Hans: 仅演示：确认信息分享步骤

en: Offline demo: no real registration, consent or payment is sent
zh-Hans: 离线演示：不会发送真实报名、同意记录或支付

en: The quote is incomplete. A known total and signature are required before confirmation.
zh-Hans: 报价不完整。确认前需要明确总额和有效报价签名。

en: Available points do not cover a deduction on this order
zh-Hans: 当前积分不足以抵扣本单

en: No payment parameters were returned. This does not confirm payment or completed registration. Read the server status.
zh-Hans: 未返回支付参数，这不能证明支付或报名已完成。请读取服务端状态。

en: No separate ticket options were supplied. The quote is requested for this activity.
zh-Hans: 未提供独立票种，将按此活动获取报价。

en: A retained submission belongs to another activity. Resolve that order before starting a new registration.
zh-Hans: 保留的报名提交属于另一活动。请先核对此订单，再开始新的报名。

en: A registration may already exist. Do not submit again. Check your orders before another attempt; this response did not provide a registration ID for a status check.
zh-Hans: 订单可能已经创建，请勿重复提交。再次报名前请先查看订单；本次响应未提供可用于查状态的报名编号。

en: Saved participants could not load. You can still enter your contact details.
zh-Hans: 参与人信息加载失败，仍可直接填写报名信息。

en: Payment parameters were received, but no payment was started. Check the server status separately.
zh-Hans: 已收到支付参数，但未发起支付。请单独读取服务端状态。

en: The current source contract requires an 11-digit mobile number starting with 1. International numbers are not supported yet.
zh-Hans: 当前来源接口要求以 1 开头的 11 位手机号，尚未支持国际号码。

en: Points cannot be used for this quote
zh-Hans: 此报价不支持积分抵扣

en: Quotes are disabled until an approved service is configured. No quote request has been sent.
zh-Hans: 配置获批准的服务前无法获取报价，尚未发送报价请求。

en: The quote could not be loaded
Request a fresh quote for this selection
zh-Hans: 请为当前选择获取最新报价

en: This submission stays locked in the current app session. Closing this sheet does not cancel the order.
zh-Hans: 此提交在当前应用会话中保持锁定。关闭此页面不会取消订单。

en: These are separate server fields. A registration label does not resolve conflicting payment or verification states.
zh-Hans: 以上是相互独立的服务端字段。报名文案不能替代或消除支付、核销状态之间的冲突。

en: Sign in again to view or continue this registration
zh-Hans: 请重新登录以查看或继续报名

en: Live registration requires separate consent to share your name and mobile number with the organizer for registration verification.
zh-Hans: 实时报名需要单独同意将姓名、手机号提供给主办方，用于报名核验。

en: This ticket is full. A verified waitlist offer is required; waitlist redemption is not available in this native form yet.
zh-Hans: 此票种已满，需要经核实的候补名额；此原生表单尚未接入候补名额兑换。

en: Server status could not be read. The existing submission remains locked.
zh-Hans: 无法读取服务端状态，原报名提交仍保持锁定。
